purpose: Find environment models by group and file name, because group folders hold topic subfolders and lazily loaded damage stages.

model_paths_v1.find: find(group: String, file: String) -> String; res:// path of the .glb in the group folder or any subfolder except damage, empty when missing
model_paths_v1.list: list(group: String) -> Array[String]; res:// paths of every placeable .glb in the group, damage stages excluded
